newsitem.title: CHINA: China Daqing H1 crude output 27.79 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China Daqing H1 crude output 27.79 mln tonnes.

text.p: China's big onshore oilfield of Daqing produced 27.79 million tonnes of crude oil in the first half of the year, the China news service said on Monday.
It gave no figure for the first half of last year but Daqing in northeastern China produced 56 million tonnes for all of 1996.
The semi-official news agency said the output for the first half met half of the target for this year.
China has been trying to stabilise production at older oilfields in eastern regions while developing western regions.
It has said it could keep output at Daqing above 50 million tonnes but it has been forced to use more expensive tertiary recovery methods to maintain such levels of production.
